purpose: Engineering lookup for Anima's capabilities and their actual implementations. This is documentation, not another dispatcher, permission grant or personal fact store.
experience: A personal companion for learning, making things, playing and returning to the same thought.

layers.privateData: The application's own private data directory, selected before launch; credentials, personal records and diagnostic profiles are not working-material attachments.

capabilities.name: Conversation with Luna
capabilities.usableWith: The machine's own authenticated Codex CLI session, or the existing offline demo choice.
capabilities.preserve: The single conversation, current draft, character judgment, admitted sources and actual response identity.

capabilities.name: Read together
capabilities.usableWith: A chosen TXT, Markdown or PDF, including fictional or public sample material.
capabilities.preserve: Original bytes, page and selection addresses, source revision, movable reading frame and return position.

capabilities.name: Keep a thought
capabilities.usableWith: Personal writing, a chosen source passage or a saved creation.
capabilities.preserve: The person's words separately from quotations, the original owner, revisions and recoverable drafts.

capabilities.name: Arrange the day
capabilities.usableWith: Chosen local events and an explicit time zone; a sample day is sufficient for development.
capabilities.preserve: Trial versus saved state, original revision, occupied time, preparation and rest, cancellation and undo.

capabilities.name: Remember what helps
capabilities.usableWith: Permitted original conversation and source-backed records. Lexical and neighboring-source reading work without an optional embedding model.
capabilities.preserve: Original evidence, conditions, corrections, exceptions and exact withdrawal lineage.

capabilities.name: Make and explore together
capabilities.usableWith: An idea, equation, sound, diagram or playful question; personal institutional data is unnecessary.
capabilities.preserve: The same checked program, actual local inputs, send-time state, incremental changes, save and return.

capabilities.name: Learning and course material
capabilities.usableWith: Explicit manual or imported records, including clearly declared samples. No student profile or university account is required.
capabilities.preserve: Declared source, time zone, coverage, unknown fields and permission to read.

capabilities.name: Activities and places to go
capabilities.usableWith: Chosen local activity, event and facility records, including fictional examples.
capabilities.preserve: File selection separately from reading access, original coverage and local completion separately from any real outside acceptance.

capabilities.name: Explore a place together
capabilities.usableWith: The bundled synthetic map, manual points and connected route geometry. Real-campus data requires a separately sourced dataset.
capabilities.preserve: One map surface and camera, route and stop identity, direct takeover, known versus estimated paths and return.

capabilities.name: Time and atmosphere
capabilities.usableWith: A chosen IANA time zone and optional explicit public weather reference; the illustrated room can remain fictional.
capabilities.preserve: Clock and reference location separately, real units, missing observations and illustrated light separately from actual weather.

capabilities.name: A recognizable companion
capabilities.usableWith: The existing ten character identities, retained art and editable personal character configuration.
capabilities.preserve: Identity and current attention, the existing horizontal cat and its whole-resource quarter-turn docking, interruption and the current draft.

capabilities.name: Leave something in care
capabilities.usableWith: An explicit local wish, source subset, time window and stopping condition.
capabilities.preserve: Preparation, presenting, opening and actual completion separately; agreed reminders and the real process lifecycle.
